reason: I check price per day, and 83 cents a day for one form of magnesium is a lot when I can get a bottle at the store for a fraction of that. The sachets are handy for my trips, but not enough to pay that much more.
objection: Why only bisglycinate when other brands put several forms of magnesium in one capsule, and why am I paying about 3 to 8 times more per day for it?
would_change_my_mind: A price near 50 cents a day or a real coupon or flash sale on the 2-box deal, plus a reason why one form beats a blend.
